# QR decoder

`zxing-0.23.0.min.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution of
`@zxing/library@0.23.0` (Apache-2.0), used by mobile_scanner's zxingJs backend.
Source: https://github.com/zxing-js/library
Distribution: https://unpkg.com/@zxing/library@0.23.0/umd/index.min.js

It is bundled locally so scanning never loads decoder code from a third-party CDN.
Camera access starts only after opening the scanner. Keep the license alongside it.
